{{Quote|This is a dangerous situation, Your Highness. Our security volunteers will be no match against a battle-hardened Federation army.|Panaka, to Queen Amidala|<ref name="Episode I" />}}
The '''Royal Naboo Security Forces''', shortened as '''Royal Security Forces''', or abbreviated as '''RNSF''' and '''RSF''', were the civilian [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A peaceful people, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] retained only volunteer [[Police officer/Legends|security officers and guards]].

==Description==
===Organization===
{{Quote|The Royal Security Forces protect the Royalty of Naboo and the sector from pirates and Rebels. Their headquarters is in the capital city of Theed.|[[Trehla Keelo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TK">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Trehla Keelo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The Royal Naboo Security Forces included the [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]], the [[Security Officer]], and the [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]]; the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Space Fighter Corps]] was another unit. Local law enforcement answered to the civilian authorities rather than the Head of Security.<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Security Forces were divided into operational units, including the [[Royal Security Police Force]],<ref name="SWG:TPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Typho - Police Work" on Naboo</ref> the [[Royal Marine Regiment]],<ref name="SWG:TSE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - Stronghold Elimination|Naboo}}</ref> the [[RSF Intelligence Division]]<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tap the Communications of the Four Major Criminal Groups|Naboo}}</ref> and the Naboo Planetary Defense.<ref name="SWG:PfT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Patrolling for Typho" in the Naboo system</ref>

[[File:Naboo_Fighter_Pilot.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A RNSF fighter pilot]]
RSF were made up of volunteers and professionals, and was split into a number of factions:
*'''Palace Guard''': Highly trained bodyguards stationed in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] who acted as bodyguards to the king or queen, or even the senator. Though few in number, the Palace Guards were the backbone of the Security Forces. They wore sleek combat helmets and red blast-dampening vests and carried [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistols]].<ref name="TPMVD" /> After the Battle of Naboo, they wore darker uniforms.
*'''Security Officers''': The top leaders of the Security Forces, these men and women were loyal yet mostly unfamiliar to true danger. They were the paid officers who worked under the captain of Security.<ref name="TPMVD" /> Roughly 1,000 in number prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they led the part-time and volunteer soldiers. They often were armed with compact, royal [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]] pistols and were protected by leather jerkins over a blue officer's coat. After the Battle of Naboo, they wore darker uniforms, with a different distribution of red and blue.
*'''Security Guard''': Naboo's equivalent to a regular infantry and to police officers, who served as patrolmen and sentries in Theed. They were large in number during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] and fired [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistols]] and the powerpacked [[CR-2 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|CR-2 heavy blaster pistols]] and were trained by Captain Panaka.<ref name="TPMVD" /> They wore flexible armor plates over a dull yellow jumpsuit. During the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]], they wore leather vests over red jumpsuits, blending them with the Palace Guards. After the Battle of Naboo, they wore darker uniforms.
*'''Fighter Pilots''': Skilled space pilots operating in and around the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. This corps included the famed [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] and fought in [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]].<ref name="TPMVD" /> They wore long orange overcoats for warmth in space and flying helmets with visors. After the Battle of Naboo, they wore darker uniforms, and a new type of helmet.
*'''[[Queen's Honor Guard]]''': A group of pilots who escorted the monarch when away from Naboo.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*'''[[Grenadier (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Grenadier]]''': Grenadiers were soldiers who were trained to use grenades.<ref name="Obi-Wan guide">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
*'''[[Naboo Royal Navy]]''': The aquatic naval forces of the Security Force. They had a base near the city of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
*'''[[Engineer/Legends|Engineers]]''': Personnel within the Royal Naboo Security Forces who were responsible for maintaining various vehicles and vessels on Naboo. They wore yellow jumpsuits and helmets that bore their first names in [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]] as their uniforms.

[[File:RSFRanks.jpg|thumb|250px|The RNSF rank insignias ranging from RSF Private to RSF Lieutenant]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Royal Naboo Security Forces were known to use at least seven distinctive ranks following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SWG:RSF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Royal Security Force}}</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
The [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]] Security Forces existed after [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Maris Magneta]] was the head of the force under [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]].<ref name="Darth" /> Magneta resigned after Veruna's mysterious [[Death/Legends|death]] and was replaced by [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], who initiated tighter security procedures for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], including training her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]].<ref name="TPMVD" /> The members often got off-world experience, but returned out of loyalty to serve.<ref name="Characters">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Security Forces were stationed in the main [[Theed Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].

===The Battle of Naboo===
[[File:Panaka1-FFp20.png|thumb|right|150px|Captain Panaka served as the head of the Naboo Security Forces during the Invasion of Naboo.]]
The Security Forces were forced into their first real battle against the organization called the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and fought valiantly, yet in vain, against its [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] legions during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> The Federation detained them in prison camps until some were freed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], while survivors formed a portion of the [[Naboo Resistance|resistance]].<ref name="BFN" /> The Federation established their own patrols on the planet. Queen Amidala and Captain Panaka rallied the troops upon their return to Naboo, and were able to capture the Federation's leader, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], and end the droid occupation.<ref name="Episode I" /> The Security Forces continued to protect Naboo following these battles, though adopted many increased security measures during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> and the eventual [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

===Clone Wars===
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Time">The events in the episode take place after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] arrived back on Naboo for the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. The Security Forces established a defensive position around the Chancellor's Podium, but a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|managed to abduct]] the Chancellor. He was successfully rescued by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>

Around that time, the [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|ELG-3A blaster pistol]] was a standard-issue [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] aboard all RSF ships, including their [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]].<ref name="TCW Ep guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref>

===The rise of the Empire===
[[File:NRSF_SecGuards.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Royal Security Force during the celebration after the invasion of Naboo]]
The Security Forces had to show their determination when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] became the new galactic order. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the security guards, along with some Gungans, [[Uprising in Theed|attacked the Imperial garrison]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The object of the attack was to stop Inquisitor [[Malorum]] from transmitting a vital secret. Ultimately, [[:Category:Fallen Jedi|ex-Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] killed the Inquisitor in the [[Plasma Refinery Complex]], while the Royal Naboo Security Forces and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] achieved the victory in the city and in the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Imperial_garrison_(Naboo)?so=search Imperial garrison]. To hide the attack an illegal weapons cache in the Theed Hangar was detonated.<ref name="Last:Death">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

However, peace for the security forces was short-lived. Naboo's then queen, [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]], had been housing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] runaways fleeing from the Empire's [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] at her own risk. When it was ordered that Apailana be executed for [[Treason/Legends|treason]], the Empire had prepared its elite [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The Security Forces tried their best to hold off the 501st during what was later called the [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|Fall of Naboo]]. However, the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] was soon besieged. The Naboo forces were quickly beheaded without a strong leader like Panaka had once been. Auto-turrets were shut down and the grid console destroyed. Most of the security and palace fighters met their dooms. At last, Apailana was assassinated in the royal plaza in the midst of the battle, allegedly by an [[Stormtrooper sniper|Imperial sharpshooter]], according to the Empire's account.<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

The Royal Naboo Security Forces were at last defeated, and most of the remaining survivors loyal to Apailana were quietly arrested and transported to the secret [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] detention centers.<ref name="BF2" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Royal Naboo Security Forces owned a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], the [[RNS Queen Amidala IV|RNS ''Queen Amidala IV'']].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===The Galactic Civil War===
The Queen's '''Royal Guard''' (established for the following queen, [[Kylantha]]) took the place of the once-experienced Royal Naboo Security Forces, who were relegated to being a type of police force. Rather than having many branches as the old security forces, the Royal Guard was made up of only a select few bodyguards whom the monarch knew personally. While the RSF continued as a small police force, protection of Naboo and its systems was mainly performed by the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] until the rise of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the weakened RSF police force had severe problems with the many criminal gangs that had swamped the planet after the rise of the Empire. At that time, the four major criminal organization on Naboo were the [[Skaak Tippers]], [[Borvo]] the Hutt's [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]], the [[Darkwalkers]] and the [[Mummers]].<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> Furthermore, other criminal groups included the [[Naboo pirates]],<ref name="SWG:PB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Pirate Bunker|Naboo}}</ref> the [[Maulers]],<ref name="SWG:MS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Mauler Stronghold|Naboo}}</ref> the [[Peddlers]],<ref name="SWG:FaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Find an Escaped Murderer" on Naboo</ref> the [[Muskegs]],<ref name="SWG:CaEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Chase an Escaped Murderer" on Naboo</ref> and the [[Mountaintop smugglers]].<ref name="SWG:DVGaF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Do Vance Groten a Favor" on Naboo</ref> With little help from the Imperial garrison, the RSF had lost the grip on the overwhelming criminal activity. Fortunately, they were able to enlist the help of groups of unidentified travelers, whose assistance enabled the Security Forces to put a stop to many gang-related crimes. [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] would on occasion delegate missions to the agents of the RSF,<ref name="SWG:TTo">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Tip-off" on Naboo</ref> as would [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]].<ref name="SWG:RtPN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to Pooja Naberrie|Naboo}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for Panaka successfully [[Confiscation of Skaak Tipper weapons crates|confiscated]]<ref name="SWG:TTo" /> Skaak Tipper weapons crates and [[Raid on the Skaak Tipper Hideout|raided]] the [[Skaak Tipper Hideout]], preventing the criminals to steal all bank terminals in [[Kaadara]].<ref name="SWG:Ttb">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tipping the balance|Naboo}}</ref> The spacer later joined the RSF under the orders of [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]. Together, they [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|eliminated]] the warlord known as the [[Mauler Usurper]],<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> [[Capture of Doogal Belstar|captured]] the criminal [[Doogal Belstar]],<ref name="SWG:TMPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Typho - More Police Work" on Naboo</ref> [[Royal Security Forces marines raid on Mauler base|assaulted]] the [[Mauler Stronghold]],<ref name="SWG:TSE" /> and [[Dogfight over Naboo|defeated]] the Naboo pirates in space.<ref name="SWG:PfT" /><ref name="SWG:SWI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Star Wing Intercept" in the Naboo system</ref>

The same year, the city of Theed was victim of a [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]]. RSF agents commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Harvin Franchels|Franchels]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Harriet Brunser|Brunser]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Karenna Dunnels|Dunnels]] and Sergeant [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] identified the Mummers as responsible and then [[Raid on the Mummer bunker|raided]] the [[Mummer bunker]] to eliminate the terrorist leaders.<ref name="SWG:HwtAotTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help with the Aftermath of the Terrorist Attack|Naboo}}</ref><ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /><ref name="SWG:HLDwitmNB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Help Lt. Dunnels with ingredients to make Neural Boosters" on Naboo</ref><ref name="SWG:BTttT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Bring Terror to the Terrorists" on Naboo</ref> Around the same time, the RSF [[Rescue of Karl Eckener|rescued]] [[Karl Eckener]], kidnapped by the Darkwalkers.<ref name="SWG:RKE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Rescue Karl Eckener" on Naboo</ref> A short time later, Lieutenant [[Sundria Khartoor]] caught the criminal [[Hunnos Jarkey]].<ref name="SWG:CtEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Catch the Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>

Later, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a coalition of remaining Naboo loyalists and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] were able to openly [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|defy]] the Empire and liberate Theed.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> However, the celebrations didn't last long, as the local Imperial garrisons put down the insurrection.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Royal Naboo Security Forces first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins.

The first hint that the Royal Naboo Security Forces possessed an aquatic fleet was in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', which included a Swamp Speeder as an unlockable. The aquatic fleet was later completely unveiled in the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.

The Security Forces appeared in LEGO form in the humorous retelling of the [[Prequel trilogy]], the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and the game's [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]].
